results.text: Comparative efficacy and safety of bumetanide and furosemide in long-term treatment of edema due to congestive heart failure. Bumetanide and furosemide were compared for efficacy in reducing edema due to congestive heart failure in 28 patients (21 receiving bumetanide and seven receiving furosemide) in a long-term study for periods from one week to 18 months.
